jobs.title: Brand Experience Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: La Tour-de-Peilz, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Brand Experience Specialist at Nestlé Suisse S.A., your mission is to rejuvenate THOMY and deepen consumer loyalty by delivering integrated brand experiences that strengthen emotional connection and drive sustainable growth. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with marketing, sales, communications, food-service teams, agencies and sponsorship partners. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Brand Experience Specialist

• Turning consumer, cultural and category insights into compelling brand experiences that grow brand relevance and commercial impact.

• Shaping an omnichannel activation strategy that creates a seamless THOMY experience across the OOH / convenience channel.

• Activating an external network to build high-value local sponsorship partnerships that expand visibility, strengthen brand meaning and unlock sustainable growth.

• Developing and executing brand activations, live marketing events and brand experiences that convert participation into lasting loyalty, engagement and advocacy.

• Delivering integrated amplification plans that connect every activation to brand priorities and measurable business outcomes.

• Driving excellent execution through clear collaboration, smart resource allocation and continuous learning from results.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in brand marketing, consumer activation, communications, or shopper marketing, while acting as a passionate ambassador for THOMY both internally and externally.

• Applying Out-of-Home market knowledge to deliver integrated omnichannel activations that strengthen brand visibility and drive business results across the region, supported by the flexibility to travel regularly and a valid driver's license.

• Using consumer insights, performance metrics, and budget management expertise to optimize execution, measure effectiveness, and maximize return on investment.

• Collaborating effectively with agencies, external partners, and cross-functional teams while leading projects from brief to successful implementation.

• Communicating fluently in Swiss German/German and English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed, and continuous learning.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to a fair and transparent internal hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

jobs.title: Regional Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Lieu : Est de la Suisse romande — cantons de Vaud, Fribourg et Valais

Taux d’activité : Temps plein, 100%

Type de Contract : Contrat à durée indéterminée

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Chez Nestlé Professional , nous accompagnons les professionnels de la restauration avec des solutions café et culinaires de premier plan, permettant aux amateurs de gastronomie à travers toute la Suisse de profiter de produits de haute qualité grâce à des marques emblématiques telles que STARBUCKS®, NESCAFÉ®, THOMY®, MAGGI®, CAILLER® et CHEF® .

En tant que Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages , vous rejoignez une équipe expérimentée et engagée. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de comptes stratégiques sur l'Est de la Suisse romande, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités commerciales, en élaborant des stratégies de croissance et en créant des partenariats durables avec vos clients.

Véritable partenaire de confiance, vous serez l'interlocuteur privilégié de vos clients et contribuerez activement au développement de votre portefeuille en conciliant acquisition de nouveaux comptes, fidélisation des clients existants et atteinte durable des objectifs commerciaux.

Votre impact en tant que Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages

• Développer et entretenir des relations partenariales solides avec les clients, en agissant comme interlocuteur privilégié et en garantissant leur satisfaction à long terme.

• Identifier et concrétiser les opportunités d’acquisition de nouveaux clients, en élaborant des offres Food & Beverages adaptées à leurs besoins.

• Piloter les négociations contractuelles jusqu’à la conclusion des accords, en assurant l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux.

• Décliner et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de vente nationale au niveau régional, en l’adaptant au contexte local et aux spécificités des clients clés.

• Suivre, analyser et piloter la performance des clients à l’aide d’indicateurs clés, et définir des plans d’action structurés afin d’atteindre, voire dépasser, les objectifs fixés.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les différentes équipes internes.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Expérience réussie dans la vente au sein du secteur HORECA, idéalement dans les domaines du café, des boissons ou des produits culinaires.

• Excellent sens de la négociation et forte orientation résultats.

• Maîtrise du français et de l’allemand indispensable; l’anglais constitue un atout.

• Autonomie, esprit d’initiative, flexibilité et forte orientation client.

Chez Nestlé Professional, les personnes sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nous mettons tout en œuvre pour offrir un environnement de travail qui favorise votre développement professionnel, votre bien-être et votre équilibre de vie:

• Des modalités de travail flexibles adaptées aux exigences du poste.

• Des congés supérieurs aux dispositions légales.

• De nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement professionnel.

• Un système de rémunération variable lié à la performance.

• Une participation aux frais de santé ainsi qu'un programme d'assistance aux collaborateurs.

• Une contribution attractive à votre prévoyance professionnelle.

• Des congés parentaux généreux et des solutions de soutien aux familles.

• Des réductions avantageuses sur une large gamme de produits et services.

Vous évoluerez au sein d'un environnement inclusif et stimulant, offrant de nombreuses opportunités de développement et de collaboration à travers les différentes activités de Nestlé.

Comment se déroule notre processus de recrutement

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience de recrutement inclusive et respectueuse. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier durant le processus, nous serons heureux de vous accompagner.

Le processus comprend généralement un entretien avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition, un entretien avec le manager recruteur et les parties prenantes concernées, suivi d’une discussion finale et d’une proposition d’embauche. Les candidatures sont examinées au fil de leur réception ; nous vous encourageons donc à postuler rapidement.

Restez vigilant(e) : Nestlé ne contactera les candidats qu’à partir d’adresses e-mail officielles de l’entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiement ou d’informations bancaires dans le cadre du processus de recrutement.

Taux d’activité : Temps plein, 100%

Type de Contract : Contrat à durée indéterminée

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Chez Nestlé Professional , nous accompagnons les professionnels de la restauration avec des solutions café et culinaires de premier plan, permettant aux amateurs de gastronomie à travers toute la Suisse de profiter de produits de haute qualité grâce à des marques emblématiques telles que STARBUCKS®, NESCAFÉ®, THOMY®, MAGGI®, CAILLER® et CHEF® .

En tant que Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages , vous rejoignez une équipe expérimentée et engagée. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de comptes stratégiques sur l'Est de la Suisse romande, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités commerciales, en élaborant des stratégies de croissance et en créant des partenariats durables avec vos clients.

Véritable partenaire de confiance, vous serez l'interlocuteur privilégié de vos clients et contribuerez activement au développement de votre portefeuille en conciliant acquisition de nouveaux comptes, fidélisation des clients existants et atteinte durable des objectifs commerciaux.

Votre impact en tant que Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages

• Développer et entretenir des relations partenariales solides avec les clients, en agissant comme interlocuteur privilégié et en garantissant leur satisfaction à long terme.

• Identifier et concrétiser les opportunités d’acquisition de nouveaux clients, en élaborant des offres Food & Beverages adaptées à leurs besoins.

• Piloter les négociations contractuelles jusqu’à la conclusion des accords, en assurant l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux.

• Décliner et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de vente nationale au niveau régional, en l’adaptant au contexte local et aux spécificités des clients clés.

• Suivre, analyser et piloter la performance des clients à l’aide d’indicateurs clés, et définir des plans d’action structurés afin d’atteindre, voire dépasser, les objectifs fixés.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les différentes équipes internes.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Expérience réussie dans la vente au sein du secteur HORECA, idéalement dans les domaines du café, des boissons ou des produits culinaires.

• Excellent sens de la négociation et forte orientation résultats.

• Maîtrise du français et de l’allemand indispensable; l’anglais constitue un atout.

• Autonomie, esprit d’initiative, flexibilité et forte orientation client.

Chez Nestlé Professional, les personnes sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nous mettons tout en œuvre pour offrir un environnement de travail qui favorise votre développement professionnel, votre bien-être et votre équilibre de vie:

• Des modalités de travail flexibles adaptées aux exigences du poste.

• Des congés supérieurs aux dispositions légales.

• De nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement professionnel.

• Un système de rémunération variable lié à la performance.

• Une participation aux frais de santé ainsi qu'un programme d'assistance aux collaborateurs.

• Une contribution attractive à votre prévoyance professionnelle.

• Des congés parentaux généreux et des solutions de soutien aux familles.

• Des réductions avantageuses sur une large gamme de produits et services.

Vous évoluerez au sein d'un environnement inclusif et stimulant, offrant de nombreuses opportunités de développement et de collaboration à travers les différentes activités de Nestlé.

Comment se déroule notre processus de recrutement

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience de recrutement inclusive et respectueuse. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier durant le processus, nous serons heureux de vous accompagner.

Le processus comprend généralement un entretien avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition, un entretien avec le manager recruteur et les parties prenantes concernées, suivi d’une discussion finale et d’une proposition d’embauche. Les candidatures sont examinées au fil de leur réception ; nous vous encourageons donc à postuler rapidement.

Restez vigilant(e) : Nestlé ne contactera les candidats qu’à partir d’adresses e-mail officielles de l’entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiement ou d’informations bancaires dans le cadre du processus de recrutement.

jobs.title: Digital Process Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Digital Process Design Engineer at Nestlé Product & Technology Center Nutrition & Health, your mission is to develop, standardize and govern process engineering drawings and digital plant models that enable safe, efficient and reusable solutions for nutrition industrialization projects. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with process and automation engineers, project managers, factory teams and equipment suppliers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Digital Process Design Engineer

• Developing accurate process diagrams, equipment layouts and three-dimensional plant models that turn engineering concepts into implementation-ready designs.

• Standardizing modular design components, drawing libraries and templates to improve quality, consistency and reuse across global projects.

• Reviewing supplier drawings and digital models to identify clashes and strengthen safety, hygiene, operability, maintainability and accessibility.

• Delivering basic engineering solutions for defined process units, including layouts, equipment interfaces, utility needs and technical specifications.

• Managing engineering data and synchronized digital plant information so teams can find, trust and use current documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

• Driving continuous improvement in design workflows and standards while sharing practical drafting knowledge with engineers, factories and suppliers.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong two-dimensional and three-dimensional drafting capability for process plants, equipment layouts and engineering documentation.

• Applying computer-aided design tools, ideally including AutoCAD, Plant 3D and Inventor, to create precise and reusable design solutions.

• Using knowledge of process equipment, piping, utilities, instrumentation and hygienic design to strengthen safe and practical layouts.

• Collaborating proactively with engineers, factory partners and suppliers while managing engineering data, revisions and document standards with care.

• Communicating confidently in English at a good working level.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

jobs.title: Technology Development Intern
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Contract type / duration: Internship, 6 months, full-time
Start date: February 2027 or flexible

Deadline for applications: 27 October 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As a Technology Development Intern at Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee, your mission is to contribute to the development and optimization of innovative manufacturing technologies for powder creamers and coffee mixes. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with technology specialists, project team members and stakeholders across NPTC Coffee. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands-on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a Technology Development Intern

• Conduct internal and external literature reviews and assess the competitive landscape to identify relevant technologies and development opportunities.

• Develop innovative solutions for powder creamers and coffee mixes based on an agreed project scope.

• Plan and execute laboratory and bench-scale activities and trials, gaining hands-on experience in technology development.

• Prepare prototypes and assess the nutritional, processing and cost impact of the solutions developed.

• Present your results to the team and key stakeholders while building an effective network across project teams and NPTC Coffee.

What will make you successful

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in progress or completed in Science and Technology, preferably Food Science, Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics or a related field.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to build trusted professional relationships.

• Effective networking and multidisciplinary teamwork skills, combined with an innovative and proactive mindset.

• Fluency in French and English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities for office-based roles

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

jobs.title: Machine Quality Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Target start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As Machine Quality Senior Specialist at Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee & Beverages , your mission is to build trust and deliver outstanding consumer experiences by embedding food safety, compliance and quality into beverage systems of both Nespresso and Nestlé Dolce Gusto from the earliest design stages. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with project managers, category teams, factories, regulatory and legal partners, consumer services and suppliers. How you’ll make an impact as a Machine Quality Senior Specialist

jobs.title: Lead Patent Counsel - Digital & AI
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland, with regular travel to Orbe and other Nestlé R&D sites
Work model: Full-time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Closing Date for Applications: 15th September 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Patent Counsel in Digital & AI, your mission is to enable and protect Nestlé’s digital, AI-driven and electronics-centric innovations through pragmatic legal services and business-driven IP protection. You will act as the go-to Legal R&D partner for Digital & AI topics across the Nestlé R&D ecosystem, collaborating closely with R&D teams, Patent Counsels, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts. This is your opportunity to shape and grow the IP strategy for one of Nestlé’s most strategic innovation frontiers.

How you’ll make an impact as a Patent Counsel – Digital & AI

• Develop and deliver the IP strategy for digital, AI and electronics-driven innovations, in close partnership with R&D teams, the patent team, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts.

• Lead business-driven patent filing and prosecution, Freedom-to-Operate assessments, oppositions of third-party patents and defense against third-party oppositions.

• Manage your patent portfolio with strong business alignment and rigorous cost management.

• Advise on IP matters in R&D collaborations, including Digital & AI partnerships, licensing and joint developments.

• Support Coffee & Systems and other categories on connected systems, digital platforms and AI-based innovations, in collaboration with category Patent Counsels.

• Partner with Nestlé Research, the Nestlé Deep Tech Center, NPTC – Nestlé Professional and other R&D centers to protect digital and AI innovations across categories.

• Promote passion for IP through awareness sessions, training and communication, while contributing to the awareness and enforcement of Nestlé patents in R&D and in the markets.

What will make you successful

• Fully qualified patent attorney, European Patent Attorney (EQE) and/or national qualification in a major jurisdiction such as the USA, with a background in Electronics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI or a related engineering discipline.

• Proven experience in digital, AI and/or electronics-related IP projects, ideally including software-implemented inventions, AI/ML, connected devices and computer-implemented business methods.

• More than 3 years of post-qualification experience with patent drafting, prosecution and Freedom-to-Operate assessments in the digital, electronics or AI space.

• Experience developing business-driven IP strategies across multiple jurisdictions, with a solid understanding of software and AI patenting specificities such as EPO, USPTO and CNIPA.

• Service-oriented, pragmatic, rigorous, hands-on and collaborative, with the ability to engage confidently with R&D partners, category teams and stakeholders at different levels of seniority.

• Fluent in English; French is a plus.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way, across different brands, businesses, functions, and regions.

• Flexible working arrangements that facilitate creativity and collaboration.

• A culture of respect, with diversity, equity, and inclusion at its core.

• A dynamic international environment empowering you to learn, develop, and grow.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives, and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference.

jobs.title: Projektingenieur Bau & Projektkoordination
jobs.description:
Standort: Basel, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Vollzeit, vor Ort, in geringem Umfang kann Home Office möglich sein

Vertragsart / Dauer: Unbefriestet

Startdatum: Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

Als Projektingenieur Bau & Projektkoordination bei der Nestlé Suisse besteht Ihre Mission darin, die Planung, Koordination und Realisierung von Bauprojekten unterschiedlicher Komplexität für unsere THOMY Fabrik in Basel sicherzustellen. Das Aufgabenspektrum reicht von kleineren Unterhalts- und Sanierungsmassnahmen bis hin zu Neu- und Umbauprojekten. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit internen Kunden, Behörden, Planern, Architekten, Ingenieuren und Unternehmern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ihre Expertise weiterzuentwickeln und die Zukunft unseres Produktionsstandorts aktiv mitzugestalten.

So werden Sie als Projektingenieur Bau & Projektkoordination einen Unterschied machen

• Selbstständige Leitung und Begleitung von Bauprojekten von der Bedürfnisdefinition bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

• Planung, Ausschreibung, Vergabe und Überwachung von Bau- und Unterhaltsmassnahmen sowie Erstellung von Projekt-, Kosten- und Terminplänen und Sicherstellung deren Einhaltung.

• Führung und Koordination von externen Planern, Architekten, Ingenieuren und Unternehmern.

• Durchführung von Zustandsanalysen und Erarbeitung von Sanierungs- und Instandhaltungskonzepten sowie Organisation und Begleitung von Umbauten, Renovationen und kleineren Neubauprojekten.

• Überwachung der Bauausführung, Durchführung von Baustellenbegehungen sowie Kontrolle von Offerten, Rechnungen und Nachträgen.

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher sowie Nestlé-interner Vorschriften zur Arbeitssicherheit, interner Vorgaben, Qualitätsstandards und Compliance-Richtlinien für den Bereich Bau sowie Ansprechperson für interne Kunden, Behörden, Planer und Unternehmer.

Das macht Sie erfolgreich

• Hintergrund als Bauingenieur, Architekt, Techniker Bauplanung/Bauführung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Erfahrung in der Projektleitung und Bauausführung.

• Erfahrung in der Planung, Koordination und Realisierung von Bau- und Umbauprojekten.

• Kenntnisse in Bauleitung, Ausschreibungen und Vergabeverfahren sowie ein gutes Verständnis für bautechnische, wirtschaftliche und organisatorische Zusammenhänge.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Behörden, Planern und Unternehmern sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise in enger Abstimmung mit den anderen Abteilungen der Fabrik.

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Organisations- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeiten sowie sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Kenntnisse von CAD- oder Projektmanagement-Tools sind von Vorteil.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Mut, Teamorientierung, Agilität und kontinuierliche Lernbereitschaft.

Bei Nestlé stehen Menschen im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns

Unsere Benefits sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Ihr Wohlbefinden zu fördern, damit Sie sowohl beruflich als auch privat erfolgreich sein können:

• Zusätzliche Ferientage über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Beitrag an Gesundheitsleistungen sowie Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program für Sie und Ihre Familie

• Attraktive Arbeitgeberbeiträge an die Pensionskasse

• Leistungsorientierter Bonus

• Grosszügige Elternzeit und umfassende Familienunterstützung

• Vielfältige Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung Ihrer Fähigkeiten

• Mitarbeiterrabatte auf verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Rekrutierungsprozess erwarten können

Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven und respektvollen Rekrutierungsprozess ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Unterstützungsmassnahmen zur Verfügung. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden durch eine starke Sicherheitskultur unterstützt. Moderne Einrichtungen und Prozesse sorgen für ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld für alle.

Der Rekrutierungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Gespräch mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Hiring Team sowie ein abschliessendes Gespräch und Angebot. Wir prüfen Bewerbungen laufend und schliessen die Ausschreibung, sobald wir eine starke Auswahl relevanter Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten identifiziert haben. Daher empfehlen wir eine frühzeitige Bewerbung. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Vorsicht vor Betrugsversuchen: Nestlé kontaktiert Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten ausschliesslich über offizielle E-Mail-Adressen des Unternehmens und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt im Rekrutierungsprozess Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit, eine Kraft für das Gute zu sein?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und beschleunigen Sie Veränderungen, die das Leben von Menschen und unseren Planeten verbessern.

Vertragsart / Dauer: Unbefriestet

Startdatum: Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

Als Projektingenieur Bau & Projektkoordination bei der Nestlé Suisse besteht Ihre Mission darin, die Planung, Koordination und Realisierung von Bauprojekten unterschiedlicher Komplexität für unsere THOMY Fabrik in Basel sicherzustellen. Das Aufgabenspektrum reicht von kleineren Unterhalts- und Sanierungsmassnahmen bis hin zu Neu- und Umbauprojekten. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit internen Kunden, Behörden, Planern, Architekten, Ingenieuren und Unternehmern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ihre Expertise weiterzuentwickeln und die Zukunft unseres Produktionsstandorts aktiv mitzugestalten.

So werden Sie als Projektingenieur Bau & Projektkoordination einen Unterschied machen

• Selbstständige Leitung und Begleitung von Bauprojekten von der Bedürfnisdefinition bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

• Planung, Ausschreibung, Vergabe und Überwachung von Bau- und Unterhaltsmassnahmen sowie Erstellung von Projekt-, Kosten- und Terminplänen und Sicherstellung deren Einhaltung.

• Führung und Koordination von externen Planern, Architekten, Ingenieuren und Unternehmern.

• Durchführung von Zustandsanalysen und Erarbeitung von Sanierungs- und Instandhaltungskonzepten sowie Organisation und Begleitung von Umbauten, Renovationen und kleineren Neubauprojekten.

• Überwachung der Bauausführung, Durchführung von Baustellenbegehungen sowie Kontrolle von Offerten, Rechnungen und Nachträgen.

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher sowie Nestlé-interner Vorschriften zur Arbeitssicherheit, interner Vorgaben, Qualitätsstandards und Compliance-Richtlinien für den Bereich Bau sowie Ansprechperson für interne Kunden, Behörden, Planer und Unternehmer.

Das macht Sie erfolgreich

• Hintergrund als Bauingenieur, Architekt, Techniker Bauplanung/Bauführung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Erfahrung in der Projektleitung und Bauausführung.

• Erfahrung in der Planung, Koordination und Realisierung von Bau- und Umbauprojekten.

• Kenntnisse in Bauleitung, Ausschreibungen und Vergabeverfahren sowie ein gutes Verständnis für bautechnische, wirtschaftliche und organisatorische Zusammenhänge.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Behörden, Planern und Unternehmern sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise in enger Abstimmung mit den anderen Abteilungen der Fabrik.

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Organisations- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeiten sowie sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Kenntnisse von CAD- oder Projektmanagement-Tools sind von Vorteil.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Mut, Teamorientierung, Agilität und kontinuierliche Lernbereitschaft.

Bei Nestlé stehen Menschen im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns

Unsere Benefits sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Ihr Wohlbefinden zu fördern, damit Sie sowohl beruflich als auch privat erfolgreich sein können:

• Zusätzliche Ferientage über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Beitrag an Gesundheitsleistungen sowie Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program für Sie und Ihre Familie

• Attraktive Arbeitgeberbeiträge an die Pensionskasse

• Leistungsorientierter Bonus

• Grosszügige Elternzeit und umfassende Familienunterstützung

• Vielfältige Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung Ihrer Fähigkeiten

• Mitarbeiterrabatte auf verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven und respektvollen Rekrutierungsprozess ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Unterstützungsmassnahmen zur Verfügung. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden durch eine starke Sicherheitskultur unterstützt. Moderne Einrichtungen und Prozesse sorgen für ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld für alle.

Der Rekrutierungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Gespräch mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Hiring Team sowie ein abschliessendes Gespräch und Angebot. Wir prüfen Bewerbungen laufend und schliessen die Ausschreibung, sobald wir eine starke Auswahl relevanter Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten identifiziert haben. Daher empfehlen wir eine frühzeitige Bewerbung. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Vorsicht vor Betrugsversuchen: Nestlé kontaktiert Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten ausschliesslich über offizielle E-Mail-Adressen des Unternehmens und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt im Rekrutierungsprozess Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

jobs.title: Global Medical Communication Lead
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a Global Medical Communication Lead at Nestlé Nutrition and Health, your mission is to shape global, healthcare professional-centred communication for the premium vitamin, mineral and supplement portfolio, translating the latest science into compelling branded and non-branded engagements that support new and existing products. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with marketing, regulatory and scientific affairs, nutrition science, research and development, regional and market teams, external agencies, research partners and scientific experts. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Medical Communication Lead

• Developing global engagement and communication plans that strengthen healthcare professional understanding and increase recommendation, advocacy and adoption across the premium vitamin, mineral and supplement portfolio.

• Creating compelling scientific communication materials across in-person, digital and social channels to support new product launches and established product concepts.

• Shaping market awareness initiatives that build scientific credibility and support sustainable portfolio growth.

• Leading global programmes, congress activities, round tables and branded and non-branded advisory engagements that deepen trusted relationships with healthcare professionals.

• Collaborating across global, regional and market teams to deliver communication toolkits that are relevant, consistent and ready for local adoption.

• Building productive partnerships with scientific experts and key opinion leaders (KOLs), agencies and research partners to turn insight and evidence into meaningful engagement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing substantial medical marketing experience in nutrition, pharmaceuticals or consumer healthcare environments.

• Applying scientific and regulatory awareness, including familiarity with external guidelines and regulations relevant to healthcare professional and advocacy relations to develop credible branded and non-branded healthcare professional programmes and materials.

• Using strategic planning, data analysis and project leadership to move multiple priorities from insight to action, with global experience highly preferred.

• Collaborating with influence and integrity across global teams while building trusted internal and external relationships.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé Nutrition and Health, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

jobs.title: Anlagenführer/-in Special Products
jobs.description:
Übersicht Position

Standort: Konolfingen, Schweiz
Unternehmen: Nestlé Schweiz S.A. Beschäftigungsgrad: 100%
Vertragsart: unbefristet
Anstellungsbeginn: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Benefits

• Internationales Arbeitsumfeld

• Durchschnittlich 41-Stunden-Woche, je nach Schichtplan

• Min. 25 Tage Ferien pro Jahr, je nach Alter mehr

• 18 Wochen bezahlter Mutterschaftsurlaub, 4 Wochen bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub

• 13. Monatslohn und Bonusmöglichkeit

• Leistungen der Pensionskasse über dem gesetzlichen Minimum

• Beiträge an die Krankentaggeldversicherung zu 100% vom Arbeitgeber bezahlt

• Schichtpauschale sowie Schichtzulagen über den gesetzlichen Vorgaben

• Kostenfreies Schichtessen

• Kostenfreier Parkplatz

• Rabatt im Nestlé Shop (vor Ort in Konolfingen)

• Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio in Konolfingen zu Sonderkonditionen

• Viele Möglichkeiten zur Karriereentwicklung und persönlichen Entfaltung

Kurzüberblick Position

550 Mitarbeitende, die für die Herstellung hochwertiger Säuglingsnahrung für das In- und Ausland zuständig sind, prägen das dynamische, hochautomatisierte Arbeitsumfeld der Fabrik Konolfingen. Dies stellt täglich hohe Ansprüche an unser Team in Bezug auf Einhaltung von Hygienebestimmungen und Arbeitssicherheit. Möchten auch Sie Teil unseres Teams sein?

Zur Verstärkung unserer Abteilung Special Products (SP) suchen wir eine kommunikative und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit als Anlagenführer/-in.

Ein Tag im Leben eines/-r Anlagenführer/-in

• Aufbereitung von Milch und Kindernahrungsmitteln mit Hilfe moderner Produktionsanlagen

• Durchführung der Rohstoffaufgabe, Sprühtrocknung sowie Mischen, Bereitstellung und Abfüllung von Pulver

jobs.title: Senior Nutrition & Health Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen, Lausanne or Vevey with flexibility to commute to the other sites (2-4 times/month)
Work model: On site / Hybrid

Activity rate: 80% -100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent Contract

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a Senior NPTC Nutrition & Health Administrative Assistant at Nestlé Product Technology Centre, your mission will be to maximize the effectiveness of the R&D Centre Head and leadership team by acting as a trusted support partner in a high-exposure position.

You will play a pivotal role in enabling senior leaders to operate effectively across a complex, multi-site R&D environment, and will bring strong judgment, anticipation, prioritization and stakeholder management skills, while coordinating sensitive operational topics with autonomy and discretion.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior NPTC Nutrition & Health Administrative Assistant

• Act as a trusted support partner to the NPTC Head and Leadership Team, enabling strategic focus and effective decision-making.

• Manage complex calendars, priorities and schedules, anticipating conflicts and ensuring timely preparation and follow-up.

• Prepare agendas, minutes, action tracking and key documents with accuracy, structure and confidentiality.

• Coordinate collaboration and information flow across Vevey, Konolfingen and other NPTC units.

• Organize leadership meetings, site events and complex workshops, including logistics, content and follow-up.

• Maintain SharePoint and intranet content, ensuring accurate and accessible information.

• Review and enhance presentations, documents and leadership communications for clarity and impact.

• Handle sensitive information with sound judgment, professionalism and discretion.

• Support newcomer onboarding and communication to help them navigate the organization.

• Provide autonomous support on audits, reporting, follow-ups and ad hoc operational priorities.

What will make you successful

• Solid experience in a senior administrative, executive assistant, coordination or project support role within an international, matrixed and fast-moving organization.

• Strong ability to manage complexity, anticipate needs, prioritize competing demands and keep senior stakeholders aligned and informed.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, especially Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel and Teams, with confidence in preparing high-quality documents, presentations and simple data follow-ups.

• Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to adapt messages for different senior stakeholders; French and/or German would be an asset in this multi-site environment.

• A proactive, resilient and solutions-oriented mindset, demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

jobs.title: Junior Research Assistant
jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: 2 years limited contract

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Junior Research Assistant in Packaging Safety at Nestlé Research, your mission is to develop, validate and apply analytical methods for novel coated paper packaging materials. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with teammates, research colleagues, operations teams, quality managers and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Junior Research Assistant in Packaging Safety

• Contribute to the development of robust analytical methods that help assess the safety and performance of innovative packaging materials.

• Perform packaging characterization analyses that support reliable research outcomes and project decisions.

• Consolidating and interpreting data and writing clear analytical documentation that enables quality, research and project teams to act with confidence.

• Participate in transferring analytical methods to operations and supporting end users throughout the method lifecycle.

• Contributing to quality, safety and knowledge-sharing practices that help teams work consistently across sites.

• Engage with internal and external partners to stay at the forefront of packaging safety science and analytical technologies.

What will make you successful

• Master’s degree in chemistry, analytical chemistry or a related scientific discipline, combined with a strong interest in analytical sciences, packaging safety and sustainable packaging technologies.

• Applying knowledge of gas chromatography-mass spectrometry, liquid chromatography-high resolution mass spectrometry or material characterization.

• Using hands-on laboratory experience from academic projects, internships or research activities to deliver reliable experimental work.

• Collaborating with curiosity, attention to detail and strong data analysis, problem-solving and scientific reporting skills.

• Working proficiency in English and French.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

jobs.title: Stagiaire Ingénieur/e Digital Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Lieu : Stage disponible sur notre centre de production d’Orbe
Taux : temps plein 100%
Type de contrat : contrat de stage à durée déterminée (6 mois)
Quand : démarrage souhaité 1er trimestre 2027

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

En tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Digital Manufacturing, vous participerez à la promotion de l'adoption de solutions numériques pour optimiser les opérations de l'usine grâce à la mise en œuvre de nouvelles solutions telles que TrendMiner, Braincube et des outils d'intelligence artificielle.

Comment aurez-vous un impact en tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Digital Manufacturing ?

• Définir et appliquer la méthodologie appropriée pour gérer un projet de solutions basées sur les données numériques
• Participer à l’amélioration continue
• Dispenser des formations et du coaching sur les outils digitaux pour accélérer la montée en compétence des Opérateurs et Techniciens.
• Assurer une présence quotidienne sur le terrain pour soutenir la montée en compétence et identifier les opportunités d’amélioration.
• S’assurer de la bonne application de nos règles de sécurité, qualité, hygiène et environnement
• Contribuer à un travail de groupe efficace
• Communiquer de façon transparente et précise.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Elève-Ingénieur-e en dernière année de formation
• Expérience terrain dans un département engineering ou production, un atout
• Connaissance en science des données
• Des compétences en programmation en Python et R atout majeur.
• Expérience en gestion de projet, un atout
• Capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes
• Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais

Avantages

• 5 semaines de vacances
• Possibilité de formation et de développement internes
• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur
• Participation financière à l’assurance maladie
• Politique parentalité avantageuse
• Restaurant d’entreprise sur place avec menus à prix subventionnés
• Parking gratuit et bornes de recharge pour voitures électriques
• Nombreux avantages auprès du Club Nespresso

jobs.title: Head of GBS Finance
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Act. Rate: Full-Time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent contract

Start date: February 2027

Deadline for applications: 25 September 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As the Head of Global Business Services Finance at Nestlé, your mission is to act as a key finance partner to the Head of GBS and the GBS Management Team. You will shape the financial roadmap, challenge business decisions, and ensure disciplined planning, performance management, cost transparency and value realization across the global GBS network. Working closely with Center Heads, End-to-End solution leads, Global Process Owners, Markets, IT & Digital, and external partners, you will provide forward-looking insights, enable fact-based decisions, and strengthen accountability for financial outcomes. You will lead an international finance team in different locations and help GBS deliver sustainable efficiency, effectiveness, and business value.

How you’ll make an impact as a Head of GBS Finance

• Bring deep expertise in the operational financial management of Global Business Services, using cost, efficiency, quality and service-performance insights to improve both efficiency and effectiveness.

jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Company: Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Start date: February 2027, flexible
Activity rate: 100%

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

The Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee is a global center of expertise for coffee and beverage innovation. Our teams in Konolfingen, Orbe, Singapore and Marysville lead coffee and beverage research and development for Nestlé markets worldwide.

As a R&D Data Science Intern, you will contribute to innovative projects across various Nestlé research and development facilities. Collaborating with Nestlé experts, you will help design the research tools of the future, contributing to advancements in data science and technology. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a R&D Data Science Intern

• Developing digital tools that enable researchers and product developers to work more effectively.

• Building computer vision models that characterize products and extract valuable information.

• Creating reliable data pipelines that turn experimental data into usable insights.

• Delivering automated reports and clear dashboards that support evidence-based decisions.

• Documenting reusable code and sharing your solutions with colleagues across research and development teams.

What will make you successful

• Current student or fresh graduate in Data Science, Computer Science or a related field

• Bringing strong programming skills in Python or R and the ability to build clear, maintainable solution

• Applying knowledge of data science, machine learning, computer vision and cloud-based application development.

• Being proactive, resourceful and curious, with the autonomy to solve problems and the openness to collaborate.

• Fluency in English, French would be an asset.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

jobs.title: Demand & Supply Planner
jobs.description:
Position snapshot

Nestlé Waters, Switzerland, Henniez

Permanent Contract

80-100%

Position summary

In this role, you will provide Nestlé Waters with the 18-month rolling best estimate of Customer Demand and improve Demand Plan accuracy. Furthermore, you will manage supply of finished products at different warehouses and manage the finished goods produced by co-packers. The main goal will be to enhance the Supply Chain responsiveness in fulfilling customer demand at optimal cost.

A day in a life of a Demand & Supply Planner:

• Ensure supply & availability of products to fulfil deliveries on time, at the right place with the correct freshness at warehouse level

• Use appropriate statistical models and parameters, interpret results to generate accurate base demand forecasts

• Drive fast, appropriate actions to minimize the impact of deviations from the Demand Plan, and communicate the implemented actions to the stakeholders

• Capture, prioritize, analyze and input Generating Demand events; customer, consumer & competitor information

• Provide Generating Demand teams with inputs on a regular basis regarding product launches, portfolio optimization, rationale of commercial decisions, promotions and customer behaviour

• Build and maintain good communication and collaboration within both Supply Chain and Generating Demand, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance, in order to deliver and satisfy our customers at optimal costs

• Support different processes within Supply Chain

What makes you successful:

• University Degree with previous internships performed ideally in Supply Chain or Commercial CFC with maturity or equivalent level with at least two years’ experience in a similar position or relevant operational experience in Supply Chain at market/business level

• Strong analytical skills

• Good communication and collaboration skills to deal with different departments (Marketing, Factory, Transport)

• Fluent in French & English any other languages is a plus

• Good command of Excel and SAP experience

titleByLocale.fr: Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Production et/ou Logistique + Amélioration Continue

jobs.description:
Lieu : stages disponibles sur nos 3 centres de production (Romont / Avenches / Orbe)
Taux : temps plein 100%
Type de contrat : contrat de stage à durée déterminée (6 mois)
Démarrage souhaité 1er trimestre 2027

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

En tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Production et/ou Logistique + Amélioration Continue , vous étudiez, proposez et prenez en charge la mise en place d’une structure d’amélioration continue inspirée de TPM (Total Performance Management) sur des lignes de production ou en zone logistique.

Comment aurez-vous un impact en tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Production et/ou Logistique + Amélioration Continue ?

• Analyser les tendances des indicateurs de performance de sa zone (fiabilité, arrêts planifiés, arrêts mineurs, pertes, blocages, …) afin d’initier des démarches de résolution de problèmes ou des projets d’améliorations et prendre les actions nécessaires pour atteindre les objectifs
• Assurer l’interface entre la production et ou logistique et les différents départements et garantir le suivi, la mise en place et la communication des actions d’améliorations de sa zone
• Coordonner les activités d’amélioration continue, de TPM et de digitalisation entre les équipes et coacher dans l’analyse et la résolution des problèmes récurrents
• Assurer la mise à jour des procédures et standard et garantir leur application

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Etudiant-e en école d’Ingénieur-e
• Connaissance des outils d’amélioration continue et/ou TPM
• Expérience dans l’industrie agro-alimentaire (un atout)
• Capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes
• Capacités à travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire
• Aisance en communication.

Avantages

• 5 semaines de vacances
• Possibilité de formation et de développement internes
• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur
• Participation financière à l’assurance maladie
• Politique parentalité avantageuse
• Restaurant d’entreprise sur place avec menus à prix subventionnés
• Parking gratuit et bornes de recharge pour voitures électriques
• Nombreux avantages auprès du Club Nespresso

jobs.title: R&D Intern - Soft Matter for Next-Generation Creamer

titleByLocale.en: R&D Intern - Soft Matter for Next-Generation Creamer
titleByLocale.it: R&D Tirocinante - Soft Matter for Next-Generation Creamer
titleByLocale.de: R&D Praktikant - Soft Matter for Next-Generation Creamer
titleByLocale.fr: R&D Stagiaire - Soft Matter for Next-Generation Creamer

jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Company: Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Activity rate: 100%

Target start date: February 2027, flexible
Deadline for applications: 15 October 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

The Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee is a global center of expertise for coffee and beverage innovation. Our teams in Konolfingen, Orbe, Singapore and Marysville lead coffee and beverage research and development for Nestlé markets worldwide.

As a R&D Intern - Soft Matter for Next-Generation Creamer, your mission is to support a research project focused on improving mouthfeel in coffee-based beverages. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with sensory experts, product developers, laboratory teams and international research colleagues to develop and apply analytical methods that help guide recipe optimization. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a R&D Intern - Soft Matter for Next-Generation Creamer

Exploring scientific literature and internal knowledge to build a clear understanding of beverage structure, mouthfeel and creaminess.

• Identifying and testing analytical approaches that help characterize mouthfeel in coffee-based beverages.

• Optimizing and implementing methods that connect laboratory measurements with sensory perception.

• Collaborating with product development and sensory teams to generate insights that support creamer and recipe optimization.

• Creating clear reports, study summaries and practical guidance that help the team apply your learnings beyond the project.

What will make you successful

• Being a student or fresh graduate in Physics, Physical Chemistry, Food Science or a related field

• Being able to connect scientific concepts to practical product challenges.

• Being hands-on, proactive and comfortable experimenting in a laboratory environment while learning by doing.

• Having an analytical mindset and the confidence to interpret data, communicate findings and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

• Fluent in English, French would be an asset.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Company: Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months
Activity rate: 100%

Target start date: February 2027, flexible
Deadline for applications: 15 October 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

The Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee is a global center of expertise for coffee and beverage innovation. Our teams in Konolfingen, Orbe, Singapore and Marysville lead coffee and beverage research and development for Nestlé markets worldwide.

As a R&D Intern - Soft Matter for Next-Generation Creamer, your mission is to support a research project focused on improving mouthfeel in coffee-based beverages. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with sensory experts, product developers, laboratory teams and international research colleagues to develop and apply analytical methods that help guide recipe optimization. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a R&D Intern - Soft Matter for Next-Generation Creamer

Exploring scientific literature and internal knowledge to build a clear understanding of beverage structure, mouthfeel and creaminess.

• Identifying and testing analytical approaches that help characterize mouthfeel in coffee-based beverages.

• Optimizing and implementing methods that connect laboratory measurements with sensory perception.

• Collaborating with product development and sensory teams to generate insights that support creamer and recipe optimization.

• Creating clear reports, study summaries and practical guidance that help the team apply your learnings beyond the project.

What will make you successful

• Being a student or fresh graduate in Physics, Physical Chemistry, Food Science or a related field

• Being able to connect scientific concepts to practical product challenges.

• Being hands-on, proactive and comfortable experimenting in a laboratory environment while learning by doing.

• Having an analytical mindset and the confidence to interpret data, communicate findings and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

• Fluent in English, French would be an asset.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

jobs.title: Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa)
jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As an Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa) at Nestlé Research, your mission is to contribute to the design and delivery of coffee and cocoa regenerative agriculture research aligned with corporate Creating Shared Value commitments and the business-endorsed Nestlé Institute of Agricultural Sciences research strategy. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with agricultural systems teams, project leaders, researchers, agronomists, operations teams, farmers, research institutes, universities and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa)

• Implementing regenerative agriculture research that advance the creation of shared value in coffee and cocoa production systems.

• Coordinate state-of-the-art field trials, data collection, and analysis with internal teams and external partners.

• Use scientific rigour to turn high-quality data collection into robust research outputs.

• Convert research findings into practical guidance and recommendations for on-farm deployment.

• Deliver novel research insights within agreed timelines, milestones, standards, and budgets.

• Build regenerative agriculture expertise to strengthen team performance and scientific collaboration.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD in agronomy, agriculture, plant science or a related discipline along with practical experience in agricultural research, field trials or applied agronomy, ideally with exposure to coffee or cocoa.

• Applying regenerative agriculture, crop management and soil health knowledge to deliver robust research outcomes.

• Using data analysis, documentation and reporting tools to create clear, traceable and actionable technical outputs.

• Collaborating across scientific, technical and operational audiences with practical problem solving, attention to detail and timely communication.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Standort: Konolfingen, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort / Vollzeit, 100%
Vertragsart / Dauer: Unbefristeter Vertrag

Be a force for good and help nurture a healthier generation

Als Milch-/Lebensmitteltechnologe Anlageführer im 1-Schichtbetrieb bei Nestlé Nutrition & Health ist deine Mission, hochwertige Produkte und Versuche sicher, zuverlässig und effizient auf unseren Produktionsanlagen umzusetzen. Du machst einen Unterschied, indem du eng mit Produktionsteams, Entwicklung, Qualität, Technik und Werkstatt zusammenarbeitest. Dies ist deine Chance, bedeutende Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die weltweit durch Ernährungsinnovation zur Verbesserung des Lebens beitragen.

So bewirkst du etwas als Milch-/Lebensmitteltechnologe Anlageführer im 1-Schichtbetrieb

• Produktherstellung unter Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften und nach NGMP/SOPs

• Vorbereitung und Durchführung der Versuche

• Erstellen von Arbeitsanweisungen, Versuchsprotokollen und Produktionsunterlagen

• Einbringen von Verbesserungsvorschlägen bei der Entwicklung neuer Produkte und Prozesse

• Mithilfe bei der Verbesserung bestehender Produkte und Verfahren

• Störungsbehebung und Wartungsarbeiten an Prozesslinien in Zusammenarbeit mit der Werkstatt

Das macht dich erfolgreich

• Ausbildung als Milch- oder Lebensmitteltechnologe oder in einem anderen Nahrungsmittelberuf

• Gutes technische Verständnis der Produktionsanlagen

• Berufserfahrung im Bereich von flüssigen Milchprodukten oder Fermentation/Filtration von Vorteil

• Neugier und Interesse für die Entwicklung von neuen Verfahren und Produkten

• Mündliche und schriftliche Englischkenntnisse oder die Bereitschaft, diese zu erlernen

• Soziale Kompetenz und Teamfähigkeit

• MS-Office-Anwenderkenntnisse

Bei Nestlé Product & Technology Center Nutrition & Health stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns

Unsere Benefits unterstützen dein Wachstum und dein Wohlbefinden, damit du bei der Arbeit und im Leben erfolgreich sein kannst:

• Bezahlte Ferien über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Beitrag an die Gesundheitsversorgung und Employee Assistance Program für dich und deine Familie

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag an deine Pensionskasse

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Grosszügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Unterstützungslösungen für Familien

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen

• Attraktive Mitarbeitendenrabatte auf Alltagsprodukte und Dienstleistungen

Was dich in unserem Rekrutierungsprozess erwartet

Wir setzen uns für eine inklusive und respektvolle Rekrutierungserfahrung ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Anpassungen bereit. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden durch eine starke Sicherheitskultur unterstützt, mit modernen Anlagen und Verfahren, die ein sicheres Umfeld für alle gewährleisten.

Der Rekrutierungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Gespräch mit Talent Acquisition, ein Gespräch mit dem Hiring Team sowie eine finale Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir prüfen Bewerbungen fortlaufend und schliessen die Stelle, sobald eine starke Auswahl passender Kandidat:innen identifiziert wurde. Deshalb empfehlen wir dir, dich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleib wachsam: Nestlé kontaktiert Kandidat:innen ausschliesslich über offizielle Unternehmens-E-Mail-Adressen und verlangt zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Rekrutierungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Bewirb dich jetzt und beschleunige Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern.

jobs.title: Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
Position snapshot

Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland

Company: Nestlé Research Konolfingen

Act. Rate: 80-100%

Type of contract: Permanent contract

Language: Fluent in English (B2 or better) and German (an advantage)

What we offer at Nestlé

Flexible work policies in terms of core hours. Please talk to us during the recruitment process about what flexibility could look like for you!

Genuine opportunities for career and personal development

Working in an international environment with the possibility to work worldwide after a successful experience in Konolfingen

Attractive additional benefits

Position summary

Our Nestlé Research and Development Center in Konolfingen (NRDK), Switzerland, develops for Nestlé worldwide, new products, processes and packaging concepts in the areas of Milk, plant-based and Nutrition products. This includes various process and filling technologies for liquid, powder or sterile products. In addition, it also provides technical assistance and engineering support for major Capital Investment Projects (CAPEX) to our factories.

As a member of our local Site-Engineering team you will support with your technical expertise and in close collaboration with your colleagues the daily pilot plant operations as well as the evaluation, design and implementation of local investment projects.

We offer a dynamic, inclusive, and international working environment with many opportunities across different companies, functions, and regions. Don’t miss the opportunity to join us and work with different teams in an agile and diverse context.

Daily activities of an Engineering Specialist

• Prepare high-level feasibility studies by asking the right questions to get a broad picture without going into too many details for new process and product ideas

• Prepare projects in further details to submit budget requests taking in account the various internal and external stakeholders of the NRDK

• Lead and execute the projects on site safely and in close collaboration with the various team members and specific operational functions leading to a successful commissioning, start-up and documented handover

• Assist our technicians/operators in troubleshooting and more complex root cause analysis on site

• Help to improve the asset intensity of our pilot plant and production facilities with detailed data analysis and specific process know-how

• Develop and drive sustainable solutions to meet our net zero goal by challenging and improving the status-quo

• Support the exploration and development of new technologies/products and help to qualify and industrialize them

What will make you successful

• Engineering degree (preferably process or mechanical engineering)

• Experience in process engineering and food industry including hygienic requirements are an advantage but not a must

• Excellent networking and communication skills

• End to end (E2E)-mindset (start projects with a clearly defined and well aligned scope ending up in successful handover including proper documentation)

• Passionate about making a difference in the professional environment

• Strong problem-solving skills as part of a bigger team and willing to apply them also in the field

• Full commitment to compliance (legal, safety, quality, finance) for all activities

• Willingness to develop specific expertise in defined areas to be the local subject matter expert

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference. We do this by fostering a diverse, friendly, supportive, and collaborative environment, that creates positive disruption, embraces innovation, and empowers people and teams to win.
We aim to hire friendly, respectful, inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.
Be a force for good. Join Nestlé and visit us on www.nestle.com.

jobs.description:
Il s'agit d'un vivier de talent. Vous serez uniquement contacté en cas d'ouverture d'un poste

Lieu : Fabrique d’Orbe, Suisse
Entité : Nestlé Suisse S.A.
Taux : CDI 100%

La Fabrique de Nestlé Suisse SA à Orbe est une référence dans la fabrication du café soluble Nescafé et de thé Special.T. Nous vous offrons un poste dans un environnement de travail dynamique favorisant l'initiative au sein d'un site industriel en plein développement où notre mission est d'atteindre l’excellence.

Résumé de la position

Notre département Engineering s’assure 7/7j et 24/24h de la disponibilité de nos installations du point de vue technique par des actions préventives, correctives, et maintenance et d’amélioration. En tant que Technicien.ne de maintenance en horaire 5x8, vous êtes responsable de la surveillance et de la maintenance de nos installations complexes de fabrication de café soluble, dans le strict respect des règles de sécurité et d'hygiène.

Une journée dans la vie d’un(e) Technicien(ne) de maintenance à la Fabrication café en 5x8

• Réaliser les dépannages des installations complexes de production de café et rédiger les rapports d’intervention.

• Procéder aux activités de maintenance préventive (mécanique, électricité) pour garantir le maintien en service des équipements.

• Analyser les causes racines des pannes et identifier les mesures de fiabilisation des lignes.

• Identifier et remonter les opportunités d'améliorations techniques sur les installations.

• Renseigner le système de gestion selon les activités réalisées (SAP)

• Participer à la création et à la mise à jour des procédures techniques.

• Durant les maintenances annuelles, assurer les activités du secteur défini en tant que leader.

• Participer à l’amélioration continue du secteur grâce aux outils TPM tels que tagging, 5s etc.

• Participer activement à la culture de la sécurité et qualité (LOTO, EPI, etc.

• Collaborer, échanger et transmettre les informations techniques avec le personnel de production et technique.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• CFC dans le domaine technique ou Technicien ES (mécanicien-électricien / automaticien ou équivalent)

• Expérience confirmée dans la maintenance et le dépannage en industrie

• Compréhension approfondie d’installations complexes de production

• Disponibilité pour travailler en horaire d’équipe 5x8 (critère pour ce poste)

• Aisance digitale et maîtrise des outils informatiques standards; connaissances de SAP sont un atout

• Autorisation de raccordement OIBT15 ou 13 est un plus

• Compétences en usinage, soudage et serrurerie est un plus.

• Autonomie, rigueur, bonne résistance au stress

• Bonnes compétences analytiques, de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes (BDA)

• Esprit d'initiative et d'équipe, orientation service

Notre département Engineering s’assure 7/7j et 24/24h de la disponibilité de nos installations du point de vue technique par des actions préventives, correctives, et maintenance et d’amélioration. • Réaliser les dépannages des installations complexes de production de café et rédiger les rapports d’intervention.

• Identifier et remonter les opportunités d'améliorations techniques sur les installations.
